title: Altitude canvas contract (Figma-observed)
description: Per-component, per-project contract extracted LIVE from a Figma component set over scripts/figma-atoms/mcp-shim.mjs, by scripts/contracts/extract-canvas.mjs. This is the CANVAS leg of the three-way contract <-> code <-> canvas comparison T6 performs; contract.schema.json is the CODE leg. The two are deliberately NOT the same schema: canvas can observe variant axes, component properties, bound-variable NAMES and text-style names, but it cannot observe a code attribute name, a `--al-*` custom-property name, an ARIA attribute, or a CSS part — those facts are recorded as `degradations` instead of fabricated. See .altitude/contracts/README.md.

$schema.description: Relative path back to this schema, e.g. "../canvas-contract.schema.json".

component.description: The custom-element tag this Figma set is mapped to in the project's parity manifest.

name.description: The Figma component-SET name, as observed.

nodeId.description: The COMPONENT_SET node id, when the manifest pins one (atoms). `null` for a set resolved by name only (molecules — ids re-mint on rebuild).

variantAxes.description: Every VARIANT-typed componentPropertyDefinition on the set: the axis name and its legal option values, as Figma records them (Title Case, unmapped to code — see contract.schema.json props[].bindings.figma.options for why label pairing is not attempted).

componentProperties.description: Every componentPropertyDefinition on the set, of any type (VARIANT/BOOLEAN/TEXT/INSTANCE_SWAP) — the full Figma-side property surface, including the non-variant properties `variantAxes` omits.

states.description: Interaction states represented as values of a "State" variant axis on this set, normalized and matched against the same enum contract.schema.json `states` uses. Empty when the set has no State axis.

textStyles.description: Named Figma text-style names bound to TEXT nodes anywhere in the sampled default-variant anatomy, deduplicated and sorted.

tokens.description: Every Figma VARIABLE name (slash-path, e.g. "theme/color/background/primary-default") bound anywhere in `anatomy`, deduplicated and sorted. Unlike contract.schema.json's `tokens` (which lists `--al-*` code custom-property names), this lists the FIGMA side of that same binding — see `degradations` for why the two are not joined here.

anatomySource.description: "observed" — `anatomy` was read from a live default-variant node. "unavailable" — the shim was unreachable, the set was not found live, or it has no default variant; `anatomy` is null. Never fabricated.

anatomyCase.description: The default variant's own Figma node name (its full "Axis=Value, ..." case string), for traceability.

code.description: Always null — a canvas-only extraction has no code-side facts. See `degradations`.

degradations.description: Every contract.schema.json fact this canvas extraction could NOT express, named explicitly rather than silently omitted or guessed — e.g. code attribute names, `--al-*` token names, ARIA attributes, CSS parts, events, slots. Adapted from ds-contracts-poc's provenance/degradation convention (see .altitude/contracts/README.md).

type.description: The Figma node type (FRAME, TEXT, INSTANCE, ...).

textStyle.description: Bound text-style name, TEXT nodes only.

boundVariables.description: Node/paint property (e.g. "fills[0].color", "itemSpacing", "cornerRadius") -> the bound Figma VARIABLE name. Never a resolved value.

children.description: Named layers, one or two levels deep only (see extract-canvas.mjs ANATOMY_DEPTH) — this is a landmark read, not a full tree dump.
